subject: Heliosmart: Executive lifeboat & customer status — action and comms
messages:
From: Priya Menon <priya.menon@heliosmart.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Duarte <alex.duarte@heliosmart.com>
Date: 2026-10-09T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Production: sudden latency and 5% errors in /v1/generate — urgent

Hi Naomi / David,

We started seeing a large spike in 95p latency around 07:42 PT this morning and a sustained ~5% error rate on our production traffic to /v1/generate. Error codes are HTTP 500s with a small subset of OOM traces in the logs. Our app (HelioServe) is reporting increased tail latency across both short and long queries — customer conversion flows are impacted.

Quick facts:
- First spike observed: 2026-10-09 07:42 PT
- 95p latency (token generation): jumped from ~180ms -> ~1.8s
- Error rate: ~5% (steady for ~25 mins and counting)
- Impact: checkout microflow failing for ~12% of sessions last 15m

We attached a dashboard snapshot and a log sample. Can you confirm if there were any changes to the model variants, routing, or quantization profiles in the last 24 hours? Also please advise on the immediate mitigation plan and an ETA for a fix.

Attachments: [heliosmart_dashboard_snapshot.png] [heliosmart_error_sample.log]

Thanks,
Priya
Senior Platform Ops
Heliosmart

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Menon <priya.menon@heliosmart.com>, Alex Duarte <alex.duarte@heliosmart.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Production: sudden latency and 5% errors in /v1/generate — urgent

Priya — thanks for the heads up and the artifacts. We’re escalating this to an executive-lifeboat channel and standing up a focused war-room.

Immediate plan (next 90 mins):
- David/Hannah: triage telemetry + identify whether this is a serving runtime regression or a routing/config hit (canary to prod delta).
- Marissa: own customer communications and set expectations. Draft a short message with what we know and next checkpoint time.
- Naomi (me): coordinate exec notification and propose SLA credit language if we can’t restore to baseline within 4 hours.

Please share any additional error samples via this thread. We’ve created a private incident record and will post live notes to the incident console.

Attachments: [initial_triage_notes.txt]

—
Naomi Feldman
Head of Customer Success (Escalations)
Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@heliosmart.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production: sudden latency and 5% errors in /v1/generate — urgent

Status update and quick telemetry:
- Correlated spike with an increased token-length distribution from Heliosmart’s batch (noted by Priya) but the latency jump magnitude suggests a kernel selection/quantization mismatch on our canary->prod path.
- Canary (q4-optimized) shows no regression; prod (q4-optimized + fallback kernels) is experiencing a fallback hot-path at 07:41 PT. Error traces indicate a transient KV cache pressure leading to OOMs on certain GPU types.

Immediate mitigation we pushed (rolling canary to 5% of prod traffic):
- Disabled the new fallback kernel path for the affected model family (rolling rollback started at 09:05 PT).
- Triggered an emergency autoscale for the affected GPU pool to reduce KV eviction pressure.

Observed effect: error rate dropped from 5% -> 2.1% within 8 minutes in the canary subset; overall prod improvement pending full rollout.

Action items:
- Hannah to validate KV cache sizing and confirm whether a patch is required to avoid OOM when fallback kernel is used.
- I’ll continue the gradual rollback and monitor 95p across regions.

Patch artifact: [gd1_patch.diff]
Live incident: https://console.redwood.ai/incidents/HLX-2026-09
PagerDuty: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-7782

—
David Kim
Sr. Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Duarte <alex.duarte@heliosmart.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@heliosmart.com>, eng-ops@heliosmart.com
Date: 2026-10-09T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production: sudden latency and 5% errors in /v1/generate — urgent

Appreciate the quick reaction. The rollback improvement on the canary is promising — thank you. Two asks from our side:
1) We need an executive-level sync in the next 2 hours to review customer impact and any SLA/credit conversation. Our execs are on standby and want a single point of contact.
2) Please confirm whether we should throttle some of our heavy queries to mitigate risk while you finish the rollback. We can toggle a temporary rate-limit if that helps.

We’re tracking user-facing counts — about ~9k sessions affected in the last hour. If you have a suggested short message for customers we can push it.

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Platform Ops
Heliosmart

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Duarte <alex.duarte@heliosmart.com>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@heliosmart.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-10T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Heliosmart — Executive update and customer-facing summary (for review)

Team,

Summary (for execs and Heliosmart leadership):
- Incident window: 2026-10-09 07:42 PT -> ongoing stabilization; major regressions mitigated by 09:15 PT (rollback + autoscale).
- Impact: Elevated 95p latency (peak ~1.8s) and transient 5% error rate; ~9k sessions potentially affected during the peak hour.
- Root cause (preliminary): Fallback kernel path combined with KV cache pressure on specific GPU types caused increased OOMs and latency. Full RCA pending.

What we did:
- Immediate rollback of fallback kernel path (canary -> prod staged rollback).
- Emergency autoscale to reduce eviction pressure.
- Telemetry checks across regions to ensure no regression on canary.

Customer commitments and next steps:
- Short-term: We recommend Heliosmart temporarily throttle their top 2 heavy query routes (if possible) for the next 3 hours — this will reduce exposure while we complete the rollback and sizing validation.
- Medium-term (24–48h): Hannah will deliver a sizing/patch plan to prevent KV cache thrash when fallback kernels are used.
- Executive offer: If we cannot fully revert to baseline latency across all traffic within 4 hours of confirmation, Redwood will propose a discretionary service credit for the impacted usage window (details to be finalized with billing/finance).

Requested materials from Heliosmart:
- A short confirmation if you can apply temporary throttles (Alex).
- Any additional log dumps for the 07:30–08:30 PT window that you can share.

Public-facing short message (proposed by Marissa, internal review):
"We identified elevated latency and errors affecting some Heliosmart flows on Oct 9. Our teams applied a targeted rollback and infrastructure adjustments; most customers have recovered. We continue to stabilize and will follow up with a full incident report."

Next checkpoints:
- 12:00 PT: internal RCA draft and patch plan (Hannah).
- 14:00 PT: exec sync (Naomi + Heliosmart leadership).
- 18:00 PT: customer-facing postmortem target (Marissa + ops).

Attachments: [executive_note_for_ceo.pdf]

Thanks all — I’ll open the exec bridge invite for 14:00 PT.

—
Naomi Feldman
Head of Customer Success (Escalations)
Redwood Inference
